Capabilities Portfolio
01 — EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Value across the whole development life cycle

BUNA Holding was established to create value across the whole construction development life cycle. With integrated capabilities in infrastructure contracting, superstructure EPC, MEP systems and facility management, these entities are designed to work in synergy, addressing the growing demand for capable and reliable operators in Saudi Arabia's rapidly evolving development landscape.

By unifying and optimizing operations across seven sectors, BUNA delivers end-to-end solutions for the construction and real-estate industry, driving quality, efficiency and sustainable growth in Saudi Arabia and the region.

02 — STRATEGIC PRINCIPLES

Empowering projects with integrated expertise

Local excellence and innovation guide every subsidiary under the BUNA umbrella, establishing new benchmarks as the region's most trusted publicly listed holding group.

03 — CORPORATE STRUCTURE

Seven sectors, one holding

BUNA Holding integrates seven sectors into one unified platform. Through its synergistic subsidiaries, BUNA delivers end-to-end construction and real-estate solutions, backed by Sumou Holding, Saudi Arabia's premier real-estate enabler and investor.

10 — STRATEGIES & APPROACHES

Value engineering, discipline and care

BUNA has managed in all its projects to offer major reduction in cost while keeping quality at a premium level. Value engineering is a core competitive advantage across current and completed projects.

Project control runs on disciplined planning, cost control and risk management, guided by a procurement philosophy built on value for money, transparency and compliance. HSE follows a continual-improvement Plan-Do-Check-Act model, and CSR balances profitability with employee welfare, community development and sustainability.

BIM Modelling Value Engineering Risk Management HSE Strategy Quality Management CSR
